title: A Building as a Repository: KIR, a Typed Intermediate Representation for Agent-Authored Building Information Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.14578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous agents that author building information models need more than access to a host API. They need a representation of what they intended, what a compiler decided on their behalf, what was refused, what was observed after execution and what remains unknown. We present KIR, a typed intermediate representation in which a building is authored as a program held in a versioned repository and lowered to host applications as build targets. KIR is organised around seven ways in which a generator writing into a stateful, partially observable host goes silently wrong, and gives each a representation in data: ambiguous selectors become typed refusals with candidates; defaults keep their provenance; obligations that will not be checked are named before execution; vacuous witnesses are rejected statically; a lost transaction response becomes the state UNCONFIRMED with a verify-before-retry rule; the reverse path obeys a census invariant; and

translated_title: 建筑即代码库：KIR——一种用于智能体编写建筑信息模型的类型化中间表示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.14578v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：自主编写建筑信息模型的智能体所需的不仅仅是访问宿主API。它们需要一种表示形式，能够表达其原本的意图是什么、编译器代表它们做出了什么决定、什么内容被拒绝了、执行之后观察到了什么，以及哪些内容仍然未知。我们提出了KIR，一种类型化中间表示，其中建筑被编写为一个保存在版本化代码库中的程序，并作为构建目标下译到宿主应用程序中。KIR围绕七种方式进行组织——这些方式是生成器在向有状态、部分可观察的宿主写入时会悄然出错的方式——并为每一种方式都提供了数据层面的表示：模糊的选择器变成带有候选列表的类型化拒绝；默认值保留其来源；不会被执行所检查的义务在执行之前被显式命名；空洞的见证被静态拒绝；丢失的事务响应变为UNCONFIRMED状态并附带“重试前先验证”规则；反向路径遵循普查不变式；以及……
tldr: 该论文提出KIR——一种类型化中间表示，将建筑编写为保存在版本化代码库中的程序，并为智能体生成器写入有状态、部分可观察的宿主时的七种悄然失败方式提供显式的数据表示，从而完整追踪意图、决策、拒绝、观察与未知状态。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes KIR, a typed intermediate representation that authors buildings as programs held in a versioned repository, providing explicit data representations for the seven silent failure modes of agent generators writing into a stateful, partially observable host.
